def ode(Y, t, params, cell_positions):
    p = params
    dY = np.zeros_like(Y)
    M = Y[:, 0]  # mRNA
    P = Y[:, 1]  # 蛋白質 (直接視為成熟的抑制子)
    
    for i in range(Y.shape[0]):
        # 轉錄雜訊
        v0_cell = p['v0'] + p['noise'] * (np.random.rand() - 0.5)
        
        # 1. mRNA 轉錄 (直接被剛生產出來的 P 抑制)
        dM = v0_cell / (1.0 + (P[i] / p['K'])**p['n']) - p['k1'] * M[i]
        
        # 2. 蛋白質轉譯 (兼具抑制子功能)
        dP = p['k2'] * M[i] - p['k3'] * P[i]
        
        dY[i, 0] = dM
        dY[i, 1] = dP
        
    return dY
